name: morphinone reductase (MR)
notes: organism as named in Results ('MR (from Pseudomonas putida M10)'); Q51990 (TrEMBL, morB, 377 aa; UniProt references include 'Purification and characterization of morphinone reductase from Pseudomonas putida M10'); no EC in the paper and none in UniProt Q51990; paper names no residue positions, so no numbering check needed; MR purified as described in refs 13, 41 (construct not described); RCSB by UniProt and by sequence (≥90%): 1GWJ (WT, entity has G at position 160 where Q51990 has E, not listed by RCSB as a mutation), 2R14 (WT, identical; MR–tetrahydroNAD complex, Pudney et al. 2007 JACS, apparently the 'preliminary x-ray diffraction data ... unpublished' structure mentioned in the paper), 3GX9 (N189A, excluded); no entry cites the paper's DOI; the paper names no MR PDB entry (its Fig. 3 model uses Old Yellow Enzyme, 'OYEA')

name: glucose dehydrogenase (BmGDH)
notes: commercial enzyme (Sigma-Aldrich G7653), used as supplied; paper names no strain or isozyme, so no UniProt accession can be assigned; reviewed B. megaterium (Priestia megaterium) glucose 1-dehydrogenases EC 1.1.1.47: P39482, P39483, P39484, P39485 (GlcDH-I to IV, strain IAM 1030), P40288 (strain IWG3), P10528 and P07999 (GdhA/GdhB, strain M1286); EC from the paper (Experimental Section); no residue positions named; pdb empty because the isozyme is unknown (structures exist for P40288: 1G6K, 1GCO, 1GEE, 1RWB and for P39485: 3AUS, 3AUT, 3AUU, 3AY6, 3AY7); the paper names no PDB entry; Introduction calls the organism 'Bacterium megaterium'

name: ht-ADH
